_comment: Every card in the game. `type` drives behaviour; the extra keys are read by the system named in each (produces/power by Game's cycle, uses/yields by PackLogic, ignored by HazardLogic).

cards.name: Scrap
cards.blurb: Twisted plating. The station is mostly this now.

cards.name: Wire
cards.blurb: Stripped from a wall that used to hold it.

cards.name: Circuit
cards.blurb: Still warm, somehow.

cards.name: Processor
cards.blurb: Halvard-issue. Rated for work nobody here survived.

cards.name: Hull Plate
cards.blurb: Rated for vacuum. Once.

cards.name: Bulkhead
cards.blurb: Braced wall. Room to work.

cards.name: Polymer
cards.blurb: Lab-grade. Smells faintly of the Dead Lab.

cards.name: Insulation
cards.blurb: Keeps heat in and the dark out.

cards.name: Fuel
cards.blurb: Half a cell. Enough to matter.

cards.name: Coolant
cards.blurb: Cold enough to burn.

cards.name: Battery
cards.blurb: Holds a charge. Barely.

cards.name: Seed
cards.blurb: Grown from ration stock. It should not be viable. It is.

cards.name: Ruin
cards.blurb: What is left of a module. An Engineer could do something with this.

cards.name: O2 Canister
cards.blurb: Three breaths of somebody else's air.

cards.name: Rations
cards.blurb: Sealed 14 months ago. Still sealed.

cards.name: Medkit
cards.blurb: Field grade. One use.

cards.name: Scrubber
cards.blurb: Pulls the carbon back out. The first thing that keeps you alive.

cards.name: Life Support
cards.blurb: A room that breathes for you.

cards.name: Atmosphere Core
cards.blurb: Halvard's own design. Holds pressure against anything.

cards.name: Greenhouse
cards.blurb: Green under cold light. The first living thing aboard in a year.

cards.name: Hydroponics Bay
cards.blurb: Racks of it, humming.

cards.name: Generator
cards.blurb: Burns fuel, makes the lights work.

cards.name: Reactor
cards.blurb: The deck hums again. It should not feel like a warning.

cards.name: Airlock
cards.blurb: Where the packs come in.

cards.name: Quarters
cards.blurb: Somewhere to stop being awake.

cards.name: Shuttle
cards.blurb: Short range. Enough to reach the middle sectors.

cards.name: Long-Range Shuttle
cards.blurb: Enough to reach the Core. Enough to leave.

cards.name: Sensor Array
cards.blurb: Listens. Catches things drifting past.

cards.name: Comms Relay
cards.blurb: Opens a channel to whatever is still answering.

cards.name: Med Bay
cards.blurb: Clean, white, unused.

cards.name: Workshop
cards.blurb: Everything is faster with a bench.

cards.name: Fabricator
cards.blurb: Feed it scrap, take circuits.

cards.name: Wreck
cards.blurb: A ship that did not make it either.

cards.name: Storage Bay
cards.blurb: Sealed, and therefore worth opening.

cards.name: Vent Shaft
cards.blurb: Narrow, hot, and full of salvage nobody reached.

cards.name: Cargo Pod
cards.blurb: Personal effects. Somebody packed to leave.

cards.name: Debris
cards.blurb: In the way. Nothing worse.

cards.name: Fire
cards.blurb: Feeding on something it should not have reached.

cards.name: Breach
cards.blurb: You can hear it.

cards.name: Contamination
cards.blurb: A bloom on the wall the colour of nothing.

cards.name: Drone
cards.blurb: Maintenance unit. Still following orders.

cards.name: Stowaway
cards.blurb: Someone else had the same idea.

cards.name: Meltdown
cards.blurb: The Reactor is past asking.

cards.name: Signal
cards.blurb: A repeating fragment. It fades if you leave it.

cards.name: Log
cards.blurb: Somebody's voice, fourteen months cold.

cards.name: ARIA
cards.blurb: The station's mind. Calm, warm, and holding something back.

cards.name: ARIA Fragment
cards.blurb: A piece of her, cached where she could not reach it.

cards.name: Reactor Core
cards.blurb: Intact. Salvaged whole from Engineering.

cards.name: Osei's Wrench
cards.blurb: Worn smooth at the grip. +2 Morale to an Engineer.

cards.name: Folded Photo
cards.blurb: Two people at a dock, squinting. +2 Morale to any crew.

cards.name: Salvager
cards.blurb: You, or someone like you.

cards.name: Scientist
cards.blurb: Knows what was grown here. Wishes she did not.

cards.name: Engineer
cards.blurb: Reads a reactor like a page.

cards.name: Medic
cards.blurb: Steady hands, no questions.

cards.name: Sector 1 Pack
cards.blurb: Sealed. Four to six cards inside.

cards.name: Sector 2 Pack
cards.blurb: Sealed. Four to six cards inside.

cards.blurb: Sealed. Four to six cards inside.

cards.blurb: Sealed. Four to six cards inside.

cards.blurb: Sealed. Four to six cards inside.
